start: Live workout started from a routine, Bench Press card (a library exercise)

user_sees: Row 'Swap exercise' with 'This workout' beside it
must_not: The row missing in a live workout

user_sees: Sheet 'Swap Bench Press', 'For this workout only. Your routine stays.'
Up to four exercises, each with a short reason
must_not: An exercise already in the workout offered
An exercise that needs equipment the plan does not have, or that loads a sore area

steps.action: Tap one, for example Dumbbell Bench Press
user_sees: The card becomes Dumbbell Bench Press for this workout
must_not: Two cards (old and new) left in the workout

start: A routine's page, editing the routine

steps.action: Tap the swap button on an exercise (screen reader: 'Swap Lat Pulldown')
user_sees: Sheet 'Swap Lat Pulldown', 'In this routine from now on. Your sets and reps stay.'
must_not: The 'For this workout only' line on the routine's sheet

user_sees: The routine shows the new exercise with the same sets and reps
must_not: The old sets and reps lost

start: Building a plan, a day's exercise list

steps.action: Tap swap on an exercise (screen reader: 'Swap Squat')
user_sees: Sheet 'Swap Squat', 'Fits your equipment and sore areas.'
must_not: Choices that ignore the plan's equipment

user_sees: The plan day shows the new exercise in the same place
must_not: The exercise moved to another day or another place

start: Live workout, the member's own exercise (not from the library)

user_sees: The full picker opens titled 'Swap exercise', with 'Instead of <name>, for this workout only'
must_not: An empty swap sheet with no way on

user_sees: It replaces the card for this workout

start: Live workout, a library exercise with no close match left (the rest are already in the workout), or the swap fails

user_sees: 'Nothing in the library is a close match. Choose any exercise below.' and 'Choose any exercise'
must_not: An empty sheet with no words

steps.action: Pick an exercise while the exercise cannot be read
must_not: The old card removed with nothing in its place
A success look for a swap that failed

start: Correcting a saved workout from history, and a live workout with sets already ticked

steps.action: While correcting a saved workout, open an exercise's menu
must_not: A swap offered while correcting a past workout

steps.action: In a live workout with two sets ticked on Bench Press, tap 'Swap exercise' and pick one
user_sees: The swap is allowed (LW-31); what happens to the ticked sets is shown plainly
must_not: Ticked sets lost without a word
Ticked sets of the old exercise counted as the new exercise's records without saying so

start: Live workout from a routine, after a swap for today

steps.action: Finish the workout, open the routine
user_sees: The routine still lists the original exercise
must_not: The routine changed by a swap that said 'For this workout only'
